 "data": " flowchart TB
 REQ[\"GET /admin/panel\"]

 REQ --> L7[\"<b>L7 balancer</b><br/>it reads the path\"]
 L7 --> L7A[\"'/admin/panel' matches<br/>location /admin/\"]
 L7A --> L7B[\"→ admin_pool<br/>→ <b>backend-1 only</b>\"]

 REQ --> L4[\"<b>L4 balancer</b><br/>it never reads the path\"]
 L4 --> L4A[\"no path to match on\"]
 L4A --> L4B[\"→ one pool<br/>→ <b>all three backends</b>\"]

 L7B --> GAP[\"<b>Capability gap, not a tuning gap.</b><br/>No config setting can give L4<br/>a 
 path it cannot see.\"]
 L4B --> GAP
